collect.hint: Record who takes “{{title}}” away. The warranty starts today.

invoice.title: Invoice {{number}}
invoice.message: Make an invoice for {{total}} for the parts and labour on this job. The job is locked afterwards: only notes, the warranty and collection can change.

returnVisit.title: Start a return visit
returnVisit.hint: A new job for the same customer and item, linked to {{number}}. It says whether the warranty was still running.

job.loadFailed: This job could not be loaded

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.hint: Small pieces of work with a person and a date.

parts.title: Parts

modeHint.stock: The part leaves the shop's stock now, at its cost.
modeHint.hand: For something bought in for this job. Type what it is and its price.

parts.priceStock: Price (leave blank for the usual price)

labour.title: Labour
labour.rateHint: {{currency}} per hour, tax included. Blank uses the usual rate.

estimates.emptyHint: Tell the customer what it will cost and record their answer.
estimates.oneDraft: Finish or send the draft before making another.
estimates.editHint: Prices are {{currency}} and include tax. A blank price uses the usual price or labour rate.
estimates.notesHint: Shown on the estimate the customer sees.
estimates.validUntilHint: Blank: the usual number of days.
estimates.sendHint: The customer gets a link to see the estimate and answer it. Sending replaces any earlier estimate.
estimates.linkOnce: Copy it now. It is shown only once; sending again makes a new link.
estimates.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
estimates.tell: Also send the link to the customer by message
estimates.told: The message is on its way to the customer
estimates.decideHint: Use this when the customer answered you in person or by phone.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.notePlaceholder: Write what happened, who you called…

summary.title: Summary
summary.needCustomer: Pick a customer on the job before invoicing: an invoice is made out to a customer record.
summary.warrantyStarts: The warranty starts when the customer collects.

receive.title: What is the job
receive.hint: Take an item in. Only the customer, the item and what is wrong are needed; the rest can wait.
receive.conditionHint: Scratches, missing parts, anything to show it was like this on arrival.
receive.customerHint: Pick a customer, or type a name and phone for someone who is not on your list.
receive.findItemHint: Search by name, plate, serial number…
receive.identifiersHint: Plate, serial number, IMEI, size, address… whatever tells it apart.
receive.checklistHint: Check these when the item arrives. They are copied into the job.
receive.templateReplace: Replace the lines below with this checklist
receive.customFailed: The job was made but its extra details could not be saved.

items.hint: Vehicles, phones, garments and places customers bring in. Every item keeps its job history.
items.emptyHint: Items are added when you receive a job, or here.
items.loadFailed: This item could not be loaded
items.noJobs: No jobs for this item yet
items.noJobsHint: Receive it to start the first one.

settings.hint: The stages jobs move through, the intake checklists, rates and the items jobs are invoiced under.

stages.title: Stages
stages.loadFailed: The stages could not be loaded
stages.roleHelp: A stage can have a special meaning. The first stage is where new jobs start; the approved stage is where a job goes when the customer says yes; the ready stage tells the customer; the collected stage starts the warranty. You can rename every stage and add your own.

kindHint.open: Someone is working on the job.
kindHint.waiting: Waiting for the customer or for parts.
kindHint.done: The work is finished but the job is not over.
kindHint.closed: The job is over and locked.

roleHint.quoted: Sending an estimate moves the job here.
roleHint.approved: An approved estimate moves the job here.
roleHint.ready: The customer is told the item is ready.
roleHint.collected: Records who collected and starts the warranty.
roleHint.closed: The job is finished and locked.
roleHint.cancelled: The job is cancelled and cannot be invoiced.

stages.name: Name
stages.codeHint: Letters, digits and underscores. It cannot be changed later.
stages.goesNowhere: A job here cannot move on
stages.removeMessage: Only a stage no job has ever used can be removed; otherwise switch it off.
stages.movesLegend: Where a job can go next
stages.movesHint: Tick the stages a job may move to from here.

checklists.title: Intake checklists
checklists.emptyHint: A checklist is the list of things to check when an item comes in. Each job copies one.
checklists.loadFailed: The checklists could not be loaded
checklists.name: Name
checklists.linesHint: One line per thing to check. Jobs already made keep the lines they copied.

rates.title: Rates and invoicing
rates.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded
rates.noInvoicing: Point of Sale is not switched on, so jobs cannot be invoiced yet.
rates.warrantyHint: Starts when the customer collects. Can be changed on each job.
rates.validHint: Counted from the day it is sent.
rates.itemHint: Jobs are invoiced under this service item. Its tax setting is the tax on the job.
rates.tell: Tell the customer when the item is ready
rates.tellHint: A message is queued when a job reaches the ready stage, if the customer can be reached.

nothing.approval: No estimate is waiting for the customer.
nothing.parts: No job is waiting for parts.
nothing.insurer: No job is waiting for an insurer.
